description_target.target_text: 30x30 grid with all colors 1-9 (no black). Maroon(9) cells are "damage" that must be inpainted — replaced with the correct color from surrounding texture. Output has no 9s; they're all repaired. ~31-72 cells change per pair. Each 9→color transition uses the local texture context to pick the right repair color. Semantic: for each 9-cell, vote among non-9 neighbors.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Kaleidoscope with 4-fold (4mm) symmetry about the off-center pivot (15.5,15.5) — the same
  ;; family as de493100: mirrors r->31-r, c->31-c plus the 90-degree rotations (r,c)->(c,31-r)/
  ;; (31-c,r). Dark-red (9) blobs occlude parts of it; the output is the grid REPAIRED IN PLACE,
  ;; each hidden cell recovered from the nearest VISIBLE member of its symmetry orbit (BFS over
  ;; the group, so compositions cover cells whose direct mirrors are also occluded).
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)))
    (define (visible? r c) (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w) (!= (at g r c) 9)))
    (define (orbit-value r0 c0)
      (let loop ((frontier (list (list r0 c0)))
                 (seen (list->set (list (list r0 c0)))))
        (if (null? frontier) 9
            (let* ((hit (findf (lambda (p) (visible? (first p) (second p))) frontier)))
              (if hit
                  (at g (first hit) (second hit))
                  (let* ((expand (for*/list ((p frontier)
                                             (q (list (list (- 31 (first p)) (second p))
                                                      (list (first p) (- 31 (second p)))
                                                      (list (second p) (- 31 (first p)))
                                                      (list (- 31 (second p)) (first p))))
                                             #:when (not (set-member? seen q)))
                                   q)))
                    (loop expand (for/fold ((s seen)) ((q expand)) (set-add s q)))))))))
    (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (rr cc)
                        (if (visible? rr cc) (at g rr cc) (orbit-value rr cc)))))))
